names.name: runs.json
names.reason: The run index (runs/store.ts, runs/run-index.ts).

names.name: runs
names.reason: The per-run event NDJSON / handoff / images directory (runs/store.ts, workflows/run.ts).

names.name: worktrees
names.reason: Task git worktrees (git-worktree.ts WORKTREES_DIR, mcp/resource-ownership.ts).

names.name: tmp
names.reason: Per-run agent scratch directories (runs/agent-tmpdir.ts, project-data-paths.ts projectScratchDir).

names.name: kit
names.reason: The project kit of a home-folder launch: projectKitDir moves the kit here so init and PUT /config never turn the user workspace file into a kit (project-kit-paths.ts).

names.name: writer-claims
names.reason: Cross-process writer-instance claims (runs/project-writer.ts).

names.name: ui-state.json
names.reason: Per-repo GUI state, direct write (ui-state.ts).

names.name: launch-key
names.reason: The `/new` prefill key, direct write, mode 0600 (server/launch-key.ts).

names.name: todos.json
names.reason: The follow-up inbox (todos.ts). `XEZ_TODOS_FILE` is only a usable path when follow-up generation is on.

names.name: onboarding-state.json
names.reason: Onboarding progress (onboarding/state.ts).

names.name: audit.ndjson
names.reason: The MCP audit trail, with `.1`–`.4` rotation and `.lock` (mcp/audit-trail.ts, AUDIT_TRAIL_FILE).

names.name: mcp-audit.ndjson
names.reason: The legacy audit trail name, read-only, never written (mcp/audit-trail.ts, LEGACY_AUDIT_TRAIL_FILE).

names.name: mcp-connection.json
names.reason: The MCP bridge connection descriptor (mcp/connection-file.ts, MCP_CONNECTION_FILE).

names.name: mcp
names.reason: The MCP subdirectory (leader cursors, …) (mcp/event-journal.ts, mcp/reconnect.ts).

names.name: mcp-owner-claims
names.reason: Cross-process MCP ownership claims (workspace/project-owner.ts, OWNER_CLAIM_DIR).

names.name: mcp-operations.ndjson
names.reason: The MCP operation-receipt journal (mcp/operation-receipts.ts, RECEIPT_JOURNAL_FILE).

names.name: mcp-operations.json
names.reason: The MCP operation-receipt snapshot (mcp/operation-receipts.ts, RECEIPT_SNAPSHOT_FILE).

names.name: automations.json
names.reason: Automation definitions (automations/store.ts DEFINITIONS, automations/coordinator.ts).

names.name: automation-state.json
names.reason: Automation runtime state (automations/store.ts STATE).

names.name: automation-receipts.ndjson
names.reason: Automation receipts (automations/store.ts RECEIPTS).

names.name: automation-log.ndjson
names.reason: Automation log (automations/store.ts LOG).

names.name: automation-poll.lock
names.reason: The automation poller’s cross-process lock (automations/store.ts, POLL_LOCK).

names.name: pi-leader.json
names.reason: The pi leader socket descriptor (mcp/adapters/pi-link.ts PI_LEADER_FILE; written by scripts/pi-leader-extension.ts DESCRIPTOR_FILE).

names.name: tasks
names.reason: Task evidence directories — written by the kit, read here for evidence-root resolution (core/run-evidence-roots.ts).

names.name: machine-state.json
names.reason: Per-machine facts of a single-project root — single-project mode only (workspace/project-machine-state.ts).

names.name: cache
names.reason: The project layout’s skills cache — single-project mode only (state-layout.ts).

names.name: ipc
names.reason: The project layout’s IPC directory — single-project mode only (state-layout.ts).
